objectives.description: Obtain Xapian tools ephemerally via nix shell nixpkgs#xapian
Run xapian-check (read-only, no --fix) against the notmuch Xapian DB
Use xapian-delve to locate the Logos/cur directory bookkeeping and message documents for the 22 targets
objectives.note: REVERSES the plan's working hypothesis: no ghost/orphaned directory record exists. All 22 UIDs resolve to live docids (73596, 73843, 73847, 73850, 73851, 73614, 73616, ... ) with a PLogos/cur path term and full tag sets (gmail, logos, proposed-archive, trash, unread). See phase4-tags-per-uid.txt for the complete per-UID docid+term dump.

objectives.description: Cross-reference: does the ghost/stuck record explain why --full-scan could not surface the files
objectives.note: No ghost record to cross-reference against -- instead traced the true cause: notmuch config get search.exclude_tags = 'deleted, spam, trash'; all 22 targets carry tag:trash; notmuch count 'path:Logos/cur and tag:trash' = 22; notmuch count 'path:Logos/cur' = 316 (22 is a subset); default (trash-excluding) search for the 22 = 0 hits; --exclude=false search for each of the 22 individually returns exactly the expected file path (phase4-all22-verification.txt), proving live indexing. --full-scan could not 'recover' the 22 in task 852 because there was nothing to recover -- they were never missing from the index; they were excluded from default search output by tag:trash + search.exclude_tags.

objectives.description: Spot-check sha256 on 2-3 mail files to confirm read-only inspection mutated nothing

approaches_tried.approach: xapian-delve directory-document search for an orphaned/ghost Logos/cur record
approaches_tried.reason: xapian-check (all four B-tree tables: docdata, termlist, postlist, position) reported 'No errors found' -- the database has no structural inconsistency. Message-document-level delve lookups for all 22 UIDs found live, well-formed documents with correct docids and terms; no separate ghost directory-document bookkeeping entry was found blocking anything.

notes: TIER 2 RESULT: xapian-check reports the Xapian glass-backend DB fully healthy across docdata/termlist/postlist/position tables -- 'No errors found'. There is no ghost or stuck directory-bookkeeping record for Logos/cur. All 22 target UIDs (145, 159, 163, 189, 200, 212, 213, 214, 215, 256, 258, 266, 271, 274, 277, 279, 280, 282, 287, 295, 300, 305) resolve to live Xapian message documents with correct docids and a PLogos/cur path term, each carrying tags: gmail, logos, proposed-archive, trash, unread. The true root cause: notmuch's search.exclude_tags = 'deleted, spam, trash' causes every default (non --exclude=false) search/count/output-files invocation to silently omit tag:trash messages -- which is exactly what task 852's on-disk-vs-indexed diff methodology (find | comm -23 against `notmuch search --output=files`) used as its 'indexed set' probe, producing a false-positive 'unindexed' classification for all 22 trash-tagged, fully-indexed files. sha256 spot-check (3 files) against Phase 1 baseline: all byte-identical, confirming the read-only xapian-check/xapian-delve inspection mutated nothing. Phase 3's decision-gate routing to Tier 2 was procedurally correct per the plan even though the underlying Tier-2 hypothesis (a ghost directory record) itself did not hold -- Tier 2 inspection is exactly what surfaced the true, non-ghost, search-exclusion cause.
